# handlr

Manage your default applications with ease using handlr!

Features

- Set default handler by extension or mime-type
- Intelligent mime type detection from files based on extension and content
- Open multiple files at once
- Set multiple handlers for mime/extension and use rofi/dmenu to pick one
- Wildcard support like `text/*`
- Automatically removes invalid/wrong `.desktop` entries from `mimeapps.list`
- Helper commands like `launch`, `get --json` for scripting needs
- Single compiled binary with no runtime dependencies

Usage

```sh
# Open a file/URL
handlr open ~/.dotfiles/pacman/packages.txt
handlr open https://google.ca

# Set default handler for png files
handlr set .png feh.desktop

# Set wildcard handler for all text files
handlr set 'text/*' nvim.desktop

# Set default handler based on mime
handlr set application/pdf evince.desktop

# List default apps
handlr list

# Get the handler for a mime/extension
$ handlr get .png
feh.desktop

# Launch a handler with given path/URL
handlr launch x-scheme-handler/https -- https://google.ca
```

Installation

- Install via your distribution's package manager if available (e.g., your distro's package named `handlr`).
- Download the latest release binary from the project's releases page and place it somewhere in your `$PATH`.
- To enable shell completions, install the appropriate completion files for your shell (place them in your shell's completions directory).

For more details, consult the project's releases and the binary distribution provided by the maintainers.

import subprocess, os, tempfile, pathlib

def make_env():
    tmp=tempfile.mkdtemp()
    env=dict(os.environ)
    env["XDG_CONFIG_HOME"]=tmp+"/config"
    env["XDG_DATA_HOME"]=tmp+"/data"
    env["XDG_DATA_DIRS"]=tmp+"/data_dirs"
    env["HOME"]=tmp+"/home"
    os.makedirs(tmp+"/config", exist_ok=True)
    os.makedirs(tmp+"/data/applications", exist_ok=True)
    os.makedirs(tmp+"/data_dirs/applications", exist_ok=True)
    os.makedirs(tmp+"/home", exist_ok=True)
    return tmp, env

def run(args, env):
    r=subprocess.run(["./executable"]+args, capture_output=True, text=True, env=env)
    print(args, "=>", r.returncode, "OUT:", repr(r.stdout), "ERR:", repr(r.stderr))
    return r

def dump(tmp):
    for root,dirs,files in os.walk(tmp):
        for f in files:
            p=os.path.join(root,f)
            print(" FILE", p, repr(open(p).read()))

tmp, env = make_env()
print(tmp)
# create a desktop file in data/applications
pathlib.Path(tmp+"/data/applications/feh.desktop").write_text("[Desktop Entry]\nType=Application\nName=Feh\nExec=feh %f\nMimeType=image/png;image/jpeg;\n")
pathlib.Path(tmp+"/data/applications/nvim.desktop").write_text("[Desktop Entry]\nType=Application\nName=Neovim\nExec=nvim %f\nTerminal=true\nMimeType=text/plain;\n")

run(["get","--json",".png"], env)
run(["list"], env)
run(["list","-a"], env)

def only_globs(tmp):
    for base in [tmp+"/data", tmp+"/data_dirs"]:
        os.makedirs(base+"/mime", exist_ok=True)
        pathlib.Path(base+"/mime/globs").write_text("image/png:*.png\n")
def only_xml(tmp):

import subprocess, os, tempfile, pathlib, time

def make_env(extra_globs=""):
    tmp=tempfile.mkdtemp()
    env=dict(os.environ)
    env["XDG_CONFIG_HOME"]=tmp+"/config"
    env["XDG_DATA_HOME"]=tmp+"/data"
    env["XDG_DATA_DIRS"]=tmp+"/data_dirs"
    env["HOME"]=tmp+"/home"
    for d in ["/config","/data/applications","/data_dirs/applications","/home","/work","/data/mime","/data_dirs/mime"]:
        os.makedirs(tmp+d, exist_ok=True)
    # default globs2
    globs = """50:image/png:*.png
50:image/jpeg:*.jpg
50:image/jpeg:*.jpeg
50:text/plain:*.txt
50:text/html:*.html
50:application/pdf:*.pdf
50:audio/mpeg:*.mp3
50:text/x-vim:*.vim
50:application/x-desktop:*.desktop
50:application/xml:*.xml
50:application/xml:*.ui
""" + extra_globs
    pathlib.Path(tmp+"/data/mime/globs2").write_text(globs)
    return tmp, env

def run(args, env, cwd=None, inp=None):
    r=subprocess.run(["/workspace/executable"]+args, capture_output=True, text=True, env=env, cwd=cwd, input=inp)
    time.sleep(0.15)
    print(args, "=>", r.returncode, "OUT:", repr(r.stdout), "ERR:", repr(r.stderr))
    return r

def write_desktop(tmp, name, content, where="data"):
    p=pathlib.Path(f"{tmp}/{where}/applications/{name}")
    p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    p.write_text(content)
    return p

def dump(tmp, skip_work=True):
    for root,dirs,files in os.walk(tmp):
        if "/work" in root and skip_work: continue
        for f in sorted(files):
            p=os.path.join(root,f)
            if "/mime/" in p: continue
            try: print(" FILE", p[len(tmp):], repr(open(p,'rb').read()))
            except Exception as e: print(e)

    tmp=tempfile.mkdtemp(); env=dict(os.environ)
    env.update({"XDG_CONFIG_HOME":tmp+"/config","XDG_DATA_HOME":tmp+"/data","XDG_DATA_DIRS":tmp+"/data_dirs","HOME":tmp+"/home"})
    if content is not None:
        p=pathlib.Path(tmp+"/config/handlr/handlr.toml"); p.parent.mkdir(parents=True); p.write_text(content)
    if mime is not None:
        pathlib.Path(tmp+"/config").mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True); pathlib.Path(tmp+"/config/mimeapps.list").write_text(mime)
    return tmp,env
def run(tmp,env,args):
    r=subprocess.run(["/workspace/executable"]+args,capture_output=True,text=True,env=env)
    files=[]
    for root,dirs,fs in os.walk(tmp):
        for f in fs: files.append(os.path.join(root,f)[len(tmp):]+"="+repr(open(os.path.join(root,f),'rb').read()))
    print(args, r.returncode, repr(r.stdout[:200]), repr(r.stderr[:500]), "FILES", files)

from harness import *

def case(desc, magic_bytes=None, extra_files=None):
    tmp, env = make_env()
    log=pathlib.Path(tmp+"/work/log"); env["LOGFILE"]=str(log)
    script=pathlib.Path(tmp+"/work/l.py"); script.write_text("#!/usr/bin/env python3\nimport sys,os\nopen(os.environ['LOGFILE'],'a').write(repr(sys.argv)+'\\n')\n"); os.chmod(script,0o755)
    for i,m in enumerate(["image/png","application/x-zerosize","text/plain","application/octet-stream"]):
        write_desktop(tmp,f"h{i}.desktop",f"[Desktop Entry]\nName=H{i}\nExec=python3 {script} {m} %f\nMimeType={m};\n")
    if magic_bytes is not None:
        pathlib.Path(tmp+"/data/mime/magic").write_bytes(magic_bytes)
    if extra_files:
        for rel,data in extra_files.items():
            p=pathlib.Path(tmp+"/data/mime/"+rel); p.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True); p.write_bytes(data if isinstance(data,bytes) else data.encode())
    for name,data in [("png_noext",b"\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n123456"),("png_as_txt.txt",b"\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n123456"),("text_noext",b"hello\n")]:
        p=pathlib.Path(tmp+"/work/"+name); p.write_bytes(data); log.write_text("")
        r=subprocess.run(["/workspace/executable","open",str(p)],capture_output=True,text=True,env=env); time.sleep(0.15)
        print(desc,name,r.returncode,repr(log.read_text().strip()),repr(r.stderr.strip()))

def case(desc, magic_bytes):
    tmp, env = make_env()

    for name,data in [("hello_noext",b"HELLO world"),("pdf_noext",b"%PDF-1.4"),("hello.txt",b"HELLO world")]:

import sys; sys.path.insert(0,"/tmp")
from harness import *
import ast
def setup(magic=None, globs_content=None, extra_mimes=None):
    tmp, env = make_env()
    if globs_content is not None: pathlib.Path(tmp+"/data/mime/globs2").write_text(globs_content)
    log=pathlib.Path(tmp+"/work/log"); env["LOGFILE"]=str(log)
    script=pathlib.Path(tmp+"/work/l.py"); script.write_text("#!/usr/bin/env python3\nimport sys,os\nopen(os.environ['LOGFILE'],'a').write(repr(sys.argv)+'\\n')\n"); os.chmod(script,0o755)
    mimes=["application/x-hello","application/x-world","application/x-zerosize","text/plain","application/octet-stream","image/png","text/x-special","application/x-binary"]
    if extra_mimes: mimes+=extra_mimes
    for i,m in enumerate(mimes): write_desktop(tmp,f"h{i}.desktop",f"[Desktop Entry]\nName=H{i}\nExec=python3 {script} {m} %f\nMimeType={m};\n")
    if magic is not None: pathlib.Path(tmp+"/data/mime/magic").write_bytes(magic)
    return tmp,env,log
def op(tmp,env,log,name,data):
    p=pathlib.Path(tmp+"/work/"+name); p.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True); p.write_bytes(data); log.write_text("")
    r=subprocess.run(["/workspace/executable","open",str(p)],capture_output=True,text=True,env=env); time.sleep(0.12)
    txt=log.read_text().strip(); mime=ast.literal_eval(txt)[1] if txt else f"ERR{r.returncode} {r.stderr.strip()}"
    print(name,repr(data[:25]),"=>",mime)
H=b"MIME-Magic\0\n"
def rules(entries):
    out=H
    for prio,mime,off,pat in entries: out+=f"[{prio}:{mime}]\n>{off}=".encode()+len(pat).to_bytes(2,'big')+pat+b"\n"
    return out
print("=== binary fallback candidates with one magic ===")
tmp,env,log=setup(rules([(80,"application/x-hello",0,b"HELLO")]))
for data in [bytes([0]),bytes([0,1,2,3,255]),b"\xff\xfe",b"a\x00b",b"a\x01b",b"a\x07b",b"a\x08b",b"a\x0bb",b"a\x0cb",b"a\x1bb",b"a\x7fb",b"text with tabs\tand cr LF\r\n",b"latin \xe9",b"\xef\xbb\xbfhello"]:
    op(tmp,env,log,"bin",data)

 ("50:application/x-hello:*.txt\n50:text/plain:*.txt\n",rules([(80,"application/x-world",0,b"HELLO")]) ),

]:
